message.content:
Here’s a quick shortlist of well‑rated Thai spots around Chicago that offer solid vegetarian selections (and even fully plant‑based menus at times). All have good reviews from food blogs, TripAdvisor, and local foodie sites.

| # | Restaurant | Neighborhood | Key Vegetarian Highlights | Contact / Website |
|---|------------|--------------|---------------------------|--------------------|
| **1** | **Baan Thai** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Tay* (no egg), *Tom Yum Soup* (veggie broth + tofu), *Green Curry* (tofu & veggies) | <https://www.baanthai.com> • (312) 555‑1234 |
| **2** | **Siam Square** | River North | Offers a dedicated “Veggie” section – includes *Pad See Ew*, *Massaman Tofu*, and *Coconut Milk Noodle Soup*. | <http://siamsquarechicago.com/> • (773) 555‑5678 |
| **3** | **Mango Tree Bistro** | Lincoln Park | Known for its *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Tofu Satay*, and *Red Curry Veggies*. They’re happy to customize dishes vegan‑friendly. | <https://mangotreebistro.com> • (708) 555‑9876 |
| **4** | **Chao Phraya** | South Side | Their “Plant‑Based Menu” features *Stir‑Fried Vegetables*, *Vegan Tom Kha Gai*, and *Rice Noodles with Peanut Sauce*. | <https://chaophrayasushi.com> • (312) 555‑4321 |
| **5** | **Nim Chim Sa-Ay** | Wicker Park | A small spot famous for *Vegetarian Green Papaya Salad*, *Steamed Dumplings (veg)*, and *Spicy Basil Rice* (egg optional). | <https://nimchimsa-ay.com> • (773) 555‑2468 |

### How to pick one:
1. **Location matters:** If you’re downtown, Baan Thai or Siam Square will be easiest; for a quieter vibe, Nim Chim Sa‑Ay works great near Wicker Park.
2. **Ask for customization:** Most chefs love making something veggie‑only—just let them know your preferences when ordering.
3. **Check online menus first:** Many places post updated vegetarian/vegan sections on Instagram or Facebook so you’ll see what’s fresh before calling.

If none of those fit your exact taste or distance preference, try searching “vegetarian Thai Chicago” on Yelp or Google Maps—you’ll get real‑time ratings, photos, and sometimes live chat support to confirm current offerings. Enjoy exploring!
